changelog:
Initial release focused on DataFrame-first PyFlink job support for Alibaba Cloud Realtime Compute for Apache Flink (VVR):

- Implements clear workflow for PyFlink job authoring, review, and deployment artifact preparation.
- Enforces DataFrame-first coding unless user requests otherwise, with table/SQL use strictly regulated.
- Provides specific routing for read-only versus implementation tasks.
- Requires exact version (VVR 11.8+) for all target contracts; marks sources/sinks for user replacement where unclear.
- Integrates connector, dependency, and runtime file resolution per official documentation and skill-scoped references.
summary: Use this skill when the user needs help with a Flink Python or PyFlink job, especially on Alibaba Cloud Realtime Compute for Apache Flink (VVR): write, modify, review, or debug PyFlink jobs; explain or select Flink Python APIs; resolve package or file dependencies for PyFlink jobs; or prepare PyFlink job deployment.
